result.summary: The page layout is largely sound, but the header action button appears to be missing its icon and the favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently, with one having poor contrast.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right of the header is an empty grey circle with only a small red notification dot — the icon (profile avatar or notification bell) is missing, so users cannot tell what the control does.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon (avatar/bell) inside the circular button, and add an accessible label describing its action.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circle with a dark outlined heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a dark-ish heart, making the icon hard to see against its background.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite button style (e.g. white/translucent circle with dark outlined heart) across all cards and ensure the icon has sufficient contrast against the button background.

issues.description: The heart icon on the dark circular button has low contrast against the dark background, potentially failing non-text contrast guidelines.
issues.suggestion: Increase icon/background contrast to at least 3:1 for interactive icon controls.
